business_summary.text: RPG Life Sciences is a pharmaceutical company with formulations and API businesses. It has separated its API business into a subsidiary RPGAP, which is now a standalone entity focused on high-value niche APIs.

corporate_actions.subject: Dividend - Rs 20 Per Share/ Special Dividend - Rs 4 Per Share

deals.execution_by: Upon closing of Investment and shareholders’ agreement dated 29th July 2026

operating_notes.text: Domestic formulations contribute 69% of sales, international formulations 18%, and APIs 13%.
RPGAP's external API sales were ₹95.1 Cr in FY26
Raghava Life Sciences facility has revenue potential of ₹200 Cr at full utilization

holders.name: INVESTOR EDUCATION AND PROTECTION FUND AUTHORITY MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹176.89 Cr, net profit ₹29.9 Cr.
RPG Life Sciences Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings call audio recording on April 30, 2026, via its website.
RPG Life Sciences Limited posted the transcript of the Q4FY26 earnings call on its website.
On May 25, 2026, RPG Life Sciences submitted its investor presentation for the Annual Investor Conference 2026.

RPG Life Sciences completes API business subsidiarization to RPGAP, raises ₹243.33 Cr from InvAscent, and acquires Actis Generics (₹80 Cr) and Raghava Life Sciences (₹135 Cr) to expand API portfolio and capacity.
RPG Life Sciences Limited schedules earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 results on October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST, hosted virtually by **Ashok Nair (MD)** and **Amol Lone (CFO)**.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for dividend at AGM
